facts.claim: The Hyderabad (Deccan) Company had spent £155,638 18s. 2d. by April 30, 1888, leaving a cash balance of £97,955 1s. 4d.
facts.quote: The report of the Directors, made up to April 30, says the expenditure to that date amounted to i'55,638 18s. 2d., leaving a balance of cash in hand of £97,955 Is. 4d.

facts.claim: The Company’s directors were advised that the title of the Company to its property was unassailable and would not be attacked.
facts.quote: They are advised and believe that the title of the Companj'' to its property is unassailable and will not be attacked.

facts.claim: Nawab Mahdi Hassan, Fathah Nawaz Jung, Bahadur, the Chief Justice of the Hyderabad State, was appointed a Director of the Company in place of Sirdar Diler- ul-Mulk, Bahadur.
facts.quote: In fact, it is greatly to the interests of the Government, both as to its credit in the market, and its prospective profits, directly from royalties, and indirectly from the opening up of the mineral resources of the State, that this Company should be left undisturbed to carry on its operations.
